trigger: Find Theo. Location depends on rep/history (engine picks the highest of rep_harbor/rep_compact/rep_authority).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You find him carrying water and ammo cans with people half again his age.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: dell. don't. everybody here is doing something. i'm sick of being the thing you carry.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: because they asked me. nobody asks me. you just decide.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: i'm skipping doses so we last longer. there. that's me helping too.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He says it like a confession and a dare at once.

choices.text: Okay. Stay. And take your insulin.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: ...really? okay. okay. i'll check in. i swear.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He hugs you, fast, like he's stealing it.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He comes. He doesn't speak the whole way home.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He walks away from you into the crowd. You don't find him again until morning.
